tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: sha brgya zan brgya'i glud bsngo ba'i cho ga zangs yag brag gi gter ma bzhugs so:

gu ru jo tse'i gter byon / na mo gu ru: bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: gdams pa 'di ni: ban bon gyi byad kha chen po zug pa'am: yang na ban bon dang kha 'gras pa'i mthu gtad ngan sngags byas pa yod pa la 'di bsngags: phyugs lug god kha sogs gdon ngos ma zin na kun la 'di bsngags so gsungs nas: rgya bod kyi so mtshams su: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad de gter du sbas: gu ru jo tses zangs yag brag ri'i gter nas bton pa'o: pad+ma'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa ma gtogs dam tshig med pa'i mi log lta can la yig cha mi ston pa dam tshig go: 'di'i lag len dang po gsog la: sha brgya zan brgya changs bu brgya: spre'u dang rta drel mdzo rog khal: dar zab la sogs bzo ras: khrab la sogs 'bul ba bkal pa bya'o: gzhan yang sran ma bra'o til zan la sogs 'bru sna gang 'dzom: rin po che'i sder mar blugs la chang phud gtsang ma byas la glud du bsngo ba ni: dang po rang gi yi dam gang mos dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed: sngags drug phyag drug gis byin rlabs byas nas byams snying rje'i ngang nas bsngo ba ni: rnga brdung zhing rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do: hūm̐: dang po rgyal byung gang nas byung: dang po phywa yi yul nas byung: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: mi yul skyi thing de ru babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: bdud las byung ba'i rgyal po de ru babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: bcom ldan thub pa'i dgra bcom de la babs: de nas rgyal bab gang du= rgyal po 'khor lo drug pa de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du= rgyal po kri kri de la= de nas rgyal babs gang du= rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan de la= de nas rgyal babs gang du= bod kyi rgyal po de la= de nas rgyal bab gang du= rngon pa mi bdun de la= de nas rgyal babs gang du= de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di la babs:

de ring gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren na: steng gi phyogs nas lha yi dbang po brgya byin yang: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gyis: gnas 'dir ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrol: 'og gi phyogs nas spyan 'dren na: dga' bo 'jog po la sogs pa: klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gyis: gnas 'dir ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrol: bcom ldan rigs gsum mgon po yang: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrol: rgya gar yul gyi rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrol: bal po'i yul gyi rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud= bzung pa thongs la= bod kyi yul nas rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud= bzung pa thongs la= phyi nang srung ma dam tshig can: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= phyi nang pho nya sum brgya drug cu yang: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= nang rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya sum brgya drug cu yang: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= g.ya' dang gangs la gnas pa yi: sman dgu la sogs thams cad kyang: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= yul gyi yul lha gnyan po yang:

rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= rgyal po sum brgya drug cu yang: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyang: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: bdud po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: rje bdud rje btsan 'khor dang bcas: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: glud chen bzang po 'di bzhes la: mi bdud dar du ma gsad cig: rta bdud bres su ma gsad cig: g.yag bdud gdang du ma gsad cig: bya bdud gdang du ma gsad cig: srog bdag srid pa'i rgyal po yang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul:

byang shar btsan rgod dmar po yang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: nyi zla la sogs gza' chen brgyad: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs kyang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: smin drug snar ma la sogs pa'i: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: rdo rje legs pa la sogs pa'i: the'u rang sum brgya drug cu yang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: ma bdud byang sman rgyal mo yang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: lcags mo gangs dkar rgyal mo yang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: phyogs bzhi'i rgyal chen sde bzhi yang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: rgyal phran sum brgya drug cu yang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: brag btsan klu btsan la sogs kyang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: btsan phran sum brgya drug cu yang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul:

ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: yul 'di'i yul lha gnyan po yang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu yang: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya= bzung pa thongs la= ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa: mthol zhing bshags so bzod par gsol: sha brgya zan brgya'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyis: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: chag chen nyam nga zlog tu gsol: su dang 'phrad pa de la sgyur: ces nad pa sogs la byed na glud bdun nam lnga la bya'o: phur kha zlog na bshos bu khrag byug pa brgya bya: yi dam gang rigs la bsang sbyang byin rlabs drag sngags bzlas shing phyogs bzhir 'phang: ngag tu 'di skad brjod: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bh+yo: bdag la phur kha'i rbod kha gtong ba zlog: gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog: gshin rje'i khram kha zug pa zlog: bon po'i rbad 'dre 'di yis zlog: mu stegs ngan sngags 'di yis= pha rol rbad 'dre 'di yis= sngags pa'i sngags zor 'di yis= zhang zhung btso zor 'di yis= bud med dmod zor 'di yis=

rgya gar ngan sngags 'di yis= brgyal nad smyo 'bog 'di yis= btsan gyi gzer kha 'di yis= sum pa'i byol zor 'di yis= klu yi nad rigs btang ba 'di yis= sman gyi bro ra bcas pa 'di yis= gdags srib spyang ki ngu ba 'di yis= dur khrod wa mo brgyal ba 'di yis= srin bya lha khang khus 'debs 'di yis= 'ug pa ha ha zer ba 'di yis= sgo khyi ngu zug byed pa 'di yis= nam gung 'og rta 'tsher ba 'di yis= byis pa'i kha brda ngan pa 'di yis= lo kag zla kag 'di yis= lo sri zla sri 'di yis= zhag kag zla kag 'di yis= mi kha bra mchu 'di yis zlog: 'di yis mi zlog gang yang med: dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' ma bcag: yon bdag 'di yi 'gal rkyen thams cad phyir zlogs shig: gzhan yang zlog pa'i tshig brjod la gtor ma phyogs bzhir bskyal lo: ༈ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/ gter ston jo bo tshe dbang dar po nas brgyud dkar po kun dga' grags pa/ dbon po yon tan bzang po/ dpe bya lha mchog bzang po// pha jo dung ru yab sras/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ grub chen klong yangs pa/ des bdag la'o/ ༈ /'di'i lag len dmar khrid kyi gsog ni/ shar du spre'u dkar po la khal bkal ba keng rus kyi ded mi/ lhor rta dmar gyi khal dang btsun pa zhwa dmar can/ nub tu dre'u nag gi khal dang btsun pa zhwa ser gyon pa/ byang du mdzo rog gi khal dang rtogs ldan dom ra can no/ khal ded mi bzhi po 'bog khur ba bya'o// bzhi po re rer changs bu sha dmar gyis brgyan pa nyer lnga dang rdzas su la rdzas klung rdzas sna tshogs gang 'byor bsham par bya'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
